coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Avalon at Mission Bay II
record.summary: Avalon at Mission Bay II, on the Assessor land parcel at 301 King St (blklot 8705011). The Assessor roll for that parcel shows 313 units and a 2006 year built, matching AvalonBay's Q4 2006 report of Avalon at Mission Bay North II, a 313-home high-rise completed that quarter (the release gives no street address, so the tie rests on the unit count).

notes.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- official DataSF Assessor parcel boundary (blklot 8705011), ~6093 sq m, not a hand trace or plan estimate. 301 King St, 313 units and completed in Q4 2006 per AvalonBay's Q4 2006 earnings release (the Assessor roll for parcel 8705011 also shows 313 units and a 2006 year built); architect not confirmed by any source found. This is the whole site/land parcel, not just the building's rooftop -- it includes any courtyard, landscaping or parking within the lot line. The parcel is condo-mapped for ownership purposes across many individually owned per-unit lots sharing this same footprint (confirmed against DataSF's Assessor parcel data), so no single blklot represents one owner and the record cannot be tied to one Assessor lot the way a single-owner parcel can.

changes.text: AvalonBay's Q4 2006 earnings release lists Avalon at Mission Bay North II (313 homes) as completed in that quarter, with initial occupancy in Q3 2006, so the completion milestone moved from June to December 2006, marked approximate. The map caveat now cites that release and the Assessor's 313 units for the unit count and opening; the Arquitectonica page it cited describes a 260-unit project matching the third phase, so the architect claim was dropped. The notes no longer state a three-phase count, and the record's summary now cites the Assessor roll and the AvalonBay release. The parcel citation now links DataSF's record for this parcel instead of the dataset's landing page. The 'Avalon at Mission Bay II' name is kept as Pier & Point's own label and noted as such.

open_questions: This record was created on 2026-09-27 to carry Pier & Point's own field photos. Its summary is limited to what its cited source confirmed when re-read that day; fuller details recorded elsewhere in Pier & Point's data (developer, architect, unit count, year built) were left out where that source didn't state them. Not yet researched: no milestones, costs or facts.

The architect of this building is not confirmed: the Arquitectonica 'Avalon Mission Bay' page describes a 260-unit development that matches Avalon at Mission Bay North III, not this 313-unit building. The 'Avalon at Mission Bay II' name is Pier & Point's label; AvalonBay's releases call it 'Avalon at Mission Bay North II'.
